profile.name: Manish Reddy
profile.summary: Backend Engineer with 3+ years of experience building production-grade APIs and microservices using Python and Node.js. Skilled in designing scalable microservices with FastAPI, Flask, and Express.js, and integrating backend systems with Generative AI applications. Experienced in optimizing databases with MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, and deploying containerized services on AWS. Proven track record of reducing API latency by 40% and delivering reliable enterprise-scale solutions.
